permissions.description: Expense claims, their review and decision

actions.description: Create, edit, attach receipts to and submit the caller's own claims
See the submitted and decided claims of the caller's direct reports, never anyone else's
Approve a submitted claim of the caller's direct reports
Reject a submitted claim of the caller's direct reports, with a reason
See every employee and their line manager
See approved claims waiting for export and every past export, and download its file
Export every approved claim not yet exported as one CSV batch

groups.name: Managers
groups.description: People who approve their team's expense claims

groups.name: Finance
groups.description: People who export approved claims to payroll

roles.name: Employee
roles.description: Files and follows their own expense claims. Sees only their own claims; never decides any claim.

roles.name: Manager
roles.description: Approves or rejects the claims of their own direct reports, never their own, and sees no other team's claims. Also files their own claims like any employee.

roles.name: PayrollOfficer
roles.description: Finance staff who exports approved claims to payroll and sets each employee's line manager. Never approves or rejects a claim and does not see claims that are not yet approved.
